description: Ask several AI assistants (Groq Qwen, Claude Haiku, Gemini, OpenAI via BlindOracle's paid-API router) the question your buyers ask, without naming your brand. Returns each model's ranked recommendations, share-of-answer and mean rank for your brand vs named competitors, the pages a live web search returns for the same question with the brands each names, and any URLs the models stated (unverified). Deterministic scoring, no LLM judge. One run is a sample: answers vary between runs. (x402: $0.10 USDC per call)
name: research.ai-answer-audit
